description.en: Given N items, each with a weight and a value, and a knapsack with maximum capacity W, find the maximum total value that can be put in the knapsack. Each item can either be included completely or excluded (0 or 1), you cannot take a fraction of an item.
description.hi: N items diye hain jinke weight aur value hain, aur ek knapsack hai jiska maximum capacity W hai. Maximum total value dhundho jo knapsack mein aa sake. Har item ya toh poora include hoga ya exclude hoga (0 ya 1), aap item ka fraction nahi le sakte.

explanation.en: Take items with weights 20 and 30 (total weight 50) for values 100 + 120 = 220
explanation.hi: Weight 20 aur 30 wale items lo (total weight 50) values 100 + 120 = 220

explanation.en: Take items with weights 3 and 4 (total weight 7) for values 4 + 5 = 9
explanation.hi: Weight 3 aur 4 wale items lo (total weight 7) values 4 + 5 = 9

hints.en: For each item, you have two choices: include it or exclude it
hints.hi: Har item ke liye do choices hain: include karo ya exclude karo

hints.en: Use a 2D DP table dp[i][w] representing max value using first i items with capacity w
hints.hi: 2D DP table dp[i][w] use karo jo first i items se capacity w mein max value represent kare

n, W = map(int, input().split())
wt = list(map(int, input().split()))
val = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(knapsack(W, wt, val, n))

approach.en: Build a 2D DP table. dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], val[i-1] + dp[i-1][w-wt[i-1]]) if wt[i-1] <= w.
approach.hi: 2D DP table banao. dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], val[i-1] + dp[i-1][w-wt[i-1]]) agar wt[i-1] <= w.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence

description.en: Given two strings s1 and s2, find the length of their Longest Common Subsequence (LCS). A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from the string by deleting some or no characters without changing the order of remaining characters.
description.hi: Do strings s1 aur s2 diye hain, unki Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) ki length dhundho. Subsequence ek aisi sequence hai jo string se kuch characters delete karke banayi ja sakti hai bina remaining characters ka order badle.

constraints: Strings contain only uppercase English letters

hints.en: If last characters match, LCS includes that character
hints.hi: Agar last characters match karte hain, toh LCS mein wo character include hoga

hints.en: If they don't match, take max of excluding one character from either string
hints.hi: Agar match nahi karte, toh kisi ek string se ek character exclude karke max lo

starterCode.python:

approach.en: Build a 2D DP table. If characters match, dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]. Otherwise dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).
approach.hi: 2D DP table banao. Agar characters match karen, dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]. Nahi toh dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

description.en: Given a sequence of matrices represented by an array p[] of dimensions where matrix i has dimensions p[i-1] x p[i], find the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to compute the product of all matrices. Print the minimum cost.
description.hi: Matrices ki ek sequence di hai jo dimensions array p[] se represent hoti hai jahan matrix i ki dimensions p[i-1] x p[i] hain. Saari matrices ka product compute karne ke liye minimum scalar multiplications dhundho. Minimum cost print karo.

explanation.en: 4 matrices with optimal parenthesization giving 30000 multiplications
explanation.hi: 4 matrices optimal parenthesization se 30000 multiplications deti hain

hints.en: Try all possible split points k between matrices i and j
hints.hi: Matrices i aur j ke beech saare possible split points k try karo

hints.en: Fill the DP table diagonally by increasing chain length
hints.hi: DP table diagonally fill karo increasing chain length ke hisaab se

description.en: Given a weighted directed graph represented as an adjacency matrix, find the shortest distances between every pair of vertices using the Floyd-Warshall algorithm. The graph may have negative edge weights but no negative weight cycles. If there is no path between two vertices, output -1.
description.hi: Ek weighted directed graph diya hai adjacency matrix ke roop mein. Floyd-Warshall algorithm use karke har pair of vertices ke beech shortest distances dhundho. Graph mein negative edge weights ho sakte hain par negative weight cycles nahi hone chahiye. Agar do vertices ke beech koi path nahi hai toh -1 output karo.

explanation.en: The output matrix shows shortest distances between all pairs. -1 in input means no direct edge.
explanation.hi: Output matrix saare pairs ke beech shortest distances dikhata hai. Input mein -1 ka matlab direct edge nahi hai.

hints.en: Consider each vertex k as a potential intermediate vertex in the shortest path
hints.hi: Har vertex k ko shortest path mein potential intermediate vertex maano

hints.en: Update dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]) for all i, j
hints.hi: Update karo dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]) saare i, j ke liye

approach.en: Three nested loops: for each intermediate vertex k, update dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]).
approach.hi: Teen nested loops: har intermediate vertex k ke liye, update karo dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]).

description.en: Given n sorted keys and their search frequencies (probabilities), construct a Binary Search Tree (BST) such that the total cost of all searches is minimized. The cost of searching a key at depth d is frequency * (d + 1). Find the minimum total search cost.
description.hi: n sorted keys aur unki search frequencies (probabilities) di hain. Ek Binary Search Tree (BST) banao taaki saari searches ki total cost minimum ho. Depth d pe key search karne ki cost frequency * (d + 1) hoti hai. Minimum total search cost dhundho.

explanation.en: Optimal BST has 30 as root, 10 as left child, 20 as right child of 10. Cost = 50*1 + 34*2 + 8*3 = 142
explanation.hi: Optimal BST mein 30 root hai, 10 left child hai, 20 node 10 ka right child hai. Cost = 50*1 + 34*2 + 8*3 = 142

hints.en: Try each key as root and recursively find optimal left and right subtrees
hints.hi: Har key ko root banao aur recursively optimal left aur right subtrees dhundho

hints.en: Similar to MCM pattern - interval DP with all possible roots between i and j
hints.hi: MCM pattern jaisa hai - interval DP saare possible roots ke saath i aur j ke beech

description.en: Given an array of coin denominations and a target amount, find the minimum number of coins needed to make up that amount. If that amount cannot be made up by any combination of the coins, return -1. You have an infinite supply of each coin denomination.
description.hi: Coin denominations ka ek array aur ek target amount diya hai. Wo amount banane ke liye minimum kitne coins chahiye ye dhundho. Agar wo amount kisi bhi combination se nahi ban sakta toh -1 return karo. Har coin denomination ka infinite supply hai.

explanation.hi: Ek 5-cent aur ek 25-cent coin use karo: 5 + 25 = 30

explanation.en: Cannot make amount 3 with only 2-cent coins
explanation.hi: Sirf 2-cent coins se amount 3 nahi ban sakta

hints.en: dp[i] = minimum coins needed to make amount i
hints.hi: dp[i] = amount i banane ke liye minimum coins

hints.en: For each amount, try all coins and take the minimum
hints.hi: Har amount ke liye saare coins try karo aur minimum lo

description.en: Given a rod of length n and a price array where price[i] denotes the price of a rod of length i+1, find the maximum revenue obtainable by cutting the rod into pieces and selling them. You can also choose not to cut the rod at all.
description.hi: Length n ki ek rod di hai aur ek price array hai jahan price[i] length i+1 ki rod ki price batata hai. Rod ko pieces mein kaat ke bech ke maximum revenue dhundho. Aap rod ko bina kaate bhi bech sakte ho.

explanation.en: Cut into pieces of length 2 and 6: price[1] + price[5] = 5 + 17 = 22
explanation.hi: Length 2 aur 6 ke pieces mein kaato: price[1] + price[5] = 5 + 17 = 22

explanation.en: Cut into two pieces of length 2: 5 + 5 = 10
explanation.hi: Do pieces of length 2 mein kaato: 5 + 5 = 10

hints.en: This is similar to the unbounded knapsack problem
hints.hi: Ye unbounded knapsack problem jaisi hai

hints.en: dp[i] = max revenue for rod of length i. Try all first-cut lengths.
hints.hi: dp[i] = length i ki rod se max revenue. Saari first-cut lengths try karo.

description.en: Given a set of n cities and the distances between every pair of cities, find the shortest possible route that visits every city exactly once and returns to the starting city (city 0). Use dynamic programming with bitmask to solve this. Print the minimum tour cost.
description.hi: n cities ka ek set diya hai aur har pair of cities ke beech ki distances di hain. Sabse chhota route dhundho jo har city ko exactly ek baar visit kare aur starting city (city 0) pe wapas aaye. Isko solve karne ke liye bitmask ke saath dynamic programming use karo. Minimum tour cost print karo.

hints.en: Use a bitmask to represent the set of visited cities
hints.hi: Visited cities ke set ko represent karne ke liye bitmask use karo

hints.en: dp[mask][i] = min cost to visit all cities in mask, ending at city i
hints.hi: dp[mask][i] = mask mein saari cities visit karne ki min cost, city i pe khatam
